facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT and National Guidance says it concluded, with MultiChoice Uganda, a strategic communications and digital skills training of 7-10 July 2025 for over 200 government communications officers, under a 2024 MoU on public-sector digital literacy.

UGA.note: Training was for government communications officers only.
